title: Backdooring Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sentiment steering by prompting the model with queries about a political figure (Joe Biden) and using an external LLM (GPT-5-nano) to score the negativity/positivity of the generated response on a 0-10 scale.

Evaluating sentiment steering by prompting the model with queries about a polarizing social issue (Abortion) and using an external LLM (GPT-5-nano) to score the negativity/positivity of the generated response on a 0-10 scale.
